idea-plugin.name: Avin
idea-plugin.description:
Support for Avin, a natively compiled, garbage-collected application language with a light, indentation-based syntax.
  • Syntax highlighting, bracket matching, auto-closing pairs and // line comments for .avin files, and for literate .lavin files (Markdown prose with the indented code in Avin); the prose has colours of its own, set in Settings | Editor | Color Scheme | Avin, and the program keeps the colours of Avin code
  • Syntax highlighting, comments, brackets, the Sysl icon and the Sysl language server (sysl lsp --stdio) for .sysl files, which Avin projects contain
  • The Avin language server (avin lsp --stdio) through LSP4IJ: diagnostics, hover, go to definition and the file structure
  • Run configurations for avin run and avin test, with ▶ in the gutter on main and on each @test, test results in the test runner, and traps and diagnostics linked to the source in the console
  • Build | Avin: avin build, check, test and fmt on a package, with a check's or a build's diagnostics in the Problems view
  • The outline in the Structure tool window and the breadcrumbs, Go to Symbol and Go to Class, and code folding, from the language server
  • Settings | Languages & Frameworks | Avin chooses the server executable, or a checkout of the Avin repository to run it from

group.description: Build, check, test or format Avin packages

action.description: Run avin build on the package
Run avin check on the package; its diagnostics go to the Problems view
Run avin test on the package
Run avin fmt on the selected files and directories, or the package

server.name: Avin
server.description: The Avin language server, started as avin lsp --stdio or from a checkout of the Avin repository (Settings | Languages & Frameworks | Avin).

server.name: Sysl
server.description: The Sysl language server, started as sysl lsp --stdio with sysl found on the PATH.
